:::{#exm-mgf-bernoulli-moments}
#### Moments of a Bernoulli random variable from its moment generating function

For $X \sim \Ber(\prob)$, @exm-mgf-bernoulli gives $M_X(t) = 1 - \prob + \prob\,\ef{t}$ for every $t$,
so $M_X^{(k)}(t) = \prob\,\ef{t}$ for every $k \ge 1$.
By @thm-mgf-moments, for every $k \ge 1$:

$$
\ba
\E{X^k}
&= M_X^{(k)}(0)
&& \text{(moments from the moment generating function)} \\
&= \prob\,\ef{0}
&& \text{(} M_X^{(k)}(t) = \prob\,\ef{t} \text{)} \\
&= \prob
&& \text{(} \ef{0} = 1 \text{)}
\ea
$$

This agrees with the direct computation of $\E{X^2}$ for a [Bernoulli](random-variables.qmd#def-bernoulli)
variable on the [expectation page](expectation.qmd#exm-lotus).
